correctness.evidence: Independent 183-line/tangent enumeration matches all three witness spectra and direction sets; 156/11232/41184/402233 polynomial forms have zero nine-direction cases, with claimed count sets.

originality.evidence: Bounded explicit spectra and family exclusion; classical Blokhuis/Rédei results predate it. Kadoo 2010 claims size-22 existence, but its printed 22-point coordinates have only 21 essential points under direct incidence check; no classification novelty claimed.

scientific_value.evidence: Replayable finite-field examples and partial nine-direction exclusion, useful narrowly; no complete size-22 decision, orbit classification, or code theorem.

limitations: Kadoo's printed witness is nonminimal as listed; its other arguments are not comprehensively assessed.
Originality restricted to bounded explicit computations.
